# My Portfolio

A full-stack web development portfolio showcasing my skills and projects.

## 🚀 Features

- Responsive design
- Interactive project showcase
- Skill demonstrations
- Contact form with WhatsApp integration
- Dark mode optimized

## 🛠️ Tech Stack

- **Frontend**: HTML, CSS, JavaScript
- **Backend**: Node.js, Express
- **Database**: MongoDB
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS

## 📁 Project Structure

```
├── index.html          # Main portfolio page
├── css/               # Stylesheets
│   ├── hero_nav.css
│   ├── about_skill.css
│   ├── projects.css
│   ├── education.css
│   ├── contact.css
│   └── res.css
├── js/                # JavaScript files
│   ├── index.js
│   ├── projects.js
│   ├── skills.js
│   └── hero-rotation.js
├── assets/            # Images and static files
└── api/              # API logic
```

## 🎯 Getting Started

1. Clone the repository
2. Open `index.html` in your browser
3. Or deploy to GitHub Pages / Netlify
